## Extended tutorials

Extended tutorials are worked analyses with executed code and output. Each one is part of the page of its method.

| Method | Platform | Tutorial |
|---|---|---|
| ANCOM-BC | R | [Differential abundance between BMI groups in the HITChip Atlas data](../tools/ancombc.qmd#extended-tutorial) |
| ANCOM-BC2 | R | [Multigroup comparison of BMI groups: global, pairwise, Dunnett-type, and trend tests](../tools/ancombc2.qmd#extended-tutorial) |
| SECOM | R | [Linear and distance correlation between taxa in the HITChip Atlas data](../tools/secom.qmd#extended-tutorial) |
| MetVAE | R | [Metabolite correlation network in stool metabolomes from patients with inflammatory bowel disease and controls](../tools/metvae.qmd#extended-tutorial) |
| TriGer | R | [Modules of gut bacterial genera and stool metabolites in inflammatory bowel disease and controls](../tools/triger.qmd#extended-tutorial) |
